comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis damper independently; record completes a tidying sequence while alternating turns with a human.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precise mechanical tool use and response-guided adjustment; record tests turn-taking and generic tidying manipulations.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two measured safe stops and a locked setting. Board record omits setup, scoring, tidying steps, alternation rules, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Human coordination and alternation are the defining tested abilities of the record, absent from the damper task.
